mechanism: Lopinavir inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, increasing chlorpromazine metabolism inhibition and elevating plasma concentrations, while chlorpromazine may inhibit lopinavir metabolism; both drugs also carry cardiac and CNS risks.
action: Monitor for increased chlorpromazine adverse effects (sedation, orthostasis, arrhythmias); consider dose reduction of chlorpromazine; monitor ECG and QTc interval; ensure therapeutic drug monitoring if available.
